summary: This update refactors the HUD and UI layer to support a new wave-based survival mechanic, introducing telemetry-heavy diagnostics and a game-over/victory modal system.
why_modified: Architectural Role: The file serves as the declarative UI skeleton for the NovaPulse engine. This burst shifts the focus from a pure sandbox simulation to a structured game loop with win/loss conditions. Behavioral Delta: Removed static object pool diagnostics in favor of high-frequency performance telemetry (CPU/GPU/Frame Delta). Added a 'Wave Announcement' banner for game state feedback and a modal overlay for session end-states. State Mutations: The HUD now tracks dynamic game-state variables like 'Entities/Pool' and 'Canvas Glow' status, and introduces a new modal DOM structure that requires integration with the main game loop for visibility toggling and stat injection.
changed_symbols: HUD elements (IDs: hud-tick-ms, hud-render-ms, hud-frame-ms, hud-entities-cap, hud-gpu-status)
Hotkey interface (Added: G, +, -, K; Modified: X)
breaking_changes: Removal of legacy object pool HUD elements may break existing JS selectors in main.js
New modal DOM structure requires CSS visibility/display state management from the main loop
Potential race condition if the game loop attempts to update removed HUD IDs before the JS update
